candidates.author: Peter Krauth
candidates.text:
Argenta 
@argentasilverag
  is still ~61% below its 52-week high.

Yet I think the investment case is getting stronger, not weaker.

High-grade silver is expanding. Gold-copper is emerging. And there’s another angle I think the market may be overlooking.


@TedJButler
  and I remain
